questions.q: When you multiply a whole number by 10, what happens to each digit?
options: It moves one place to the left
It moves two places to the left
It moves one place to the right
It stays in the same place
questions.why: The script says multiplying by ten moves every digit one place to the left.
The script shows 4 × 100 = 400, with two zeros appearing.

questions.q: Following the rule in the video, what is 7 × 10?
questions.why: Times ten adds one zero, so 7 × 10 = 70.
